messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: Spike in 5xx/timeouts for /v1/generate (us-east-1). 5xx rate up to 3.4% over baseline, p95 latency 2.1s -> 7.8s. Alert: PG-HighErrors. dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/…

oncall_elena: taking this — paging current oncall (sam) and platform. tagging eng-sre.

sam: I’m on it, looking at gateway logs now. do we know if this is region-wide or just a cluster?

mike: customer-impact: Hosted API customers are seeing increased timeouts + client retries. Support reports ~30 tickets in last 15m, a few customers hit request failures >1% — potentially user-facing for heavy ingestion jobs.

jess: quick note: traces for these failing requests are sparse. I’m not seeing request_id in many gateway logs, so correlation is poor. possible observability gap introduced by last config change to log forwarder.

sam: ok — immediate mitigations I can try: reduce upstream concurrency/burst at gateway, enable short circuiting to fallback model, and flip on verbose request_id passthrough in ingress. I need a short window to roll these.

oncall_elena: do it. also we need stopgap instrumentation so we can see root cause while we mitigate. jess, can you add request-id injection and bump trace sampling?

jess: I can patch the ingress to inject X-Req-Id header and turn on structured debug logging for 30m. Doing a small canary to avoid log flood.

jess: command I’ll run on canary:
```
kubectl -n gateway patch deploy gateway-canary --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"EXTRA_HEADERS","value":"X-Req-Id"}}]'
```
will also toggle TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1 -> 1.0 for the canary.

ops-bot: deploy triggered: gateway-canary patch (jess) — build/sha: defa45c — link: https://ci.internal/job/1234 :white_check_mark:

sam: after canary results look ok, we should promote to primary. I also enabled a short-lived rate-limit rule to slow large clients: `limit_by_header: X-Api-Key` to 200rps.

jess: can we also re-enable jaeger sampling for this route? current rate is 0.02 due to prior change. I'll POST to jaeger-admin to increase to 0.5 for 20m.

tariq: flag: upstream latency histogram from envoy was removed in last exporter cleanup (PR #467). I’m going to re-enable the exporter config as a stopgap so we have per-upstream latency metrics. Applying small config via k8s: `kubectl apply -f stopgap-envoy-exporter.yaml`

oncall_elena: good. can someone collect a short customer impact summary for comms/status page? we need a PSR.

mike: drafted impact: "Hosted API (us-east-1): elevated 5xx and timeouts affecting ~3% of requests from a subset of customers; degraded latency for all customers. No full regional outage. Teams: APAC unaffected. Known customers with elevated failures: AcmeCorp, BetaLabs."

sam: +1. include that retries may increase client-side cost.

incident-bot: Incident PG-HighErrors changed to MONITORING — mitigations applied: gateway rate-limit, request-id injection, jaeger sampling bump.

jess: after request-id injection and increased sampling I can see traces correlating to a particular backend pool. There are intermittent 504s when slow-worker nodes get burst traffic and kv-cache misses spike the backend CPU.

sam: good find. immediately scaling the backend pool + enabling a short cache-TTL extension to reduce backend hits. Patch to autoscaler: `kubectl -n models scale deployment model-backend --replicas=6` (temporary).

mike: ops note: scaled to 6, cache TTL extended from 60s -> 300s for the hot path. initial error rate dropped to ~0.6% in last 5m.

oncall_elena: thanks. next steps: leave instrumentation enabled for 2h, keep sampling high, roll a proper fix for exporter config and add request-id at ingress permanently in next release. create follow-up ticket to revert spiky sampling and TTL changes when stable.

jess: FYI — trace backlog shows missing spans for about ~12% of failed requests prior to the stopgap. postmortem should call out that log-forwarder change removed request_id propagation + adjusted sampler to low rate; that's why we lacked visibility.

sam: handing off oncall to elena at 22:00 UTC — I'm clear on mitigations: request-id injection (done), gateway rate-limit (done), backend scaled & cache TTL increased, jaeger sampling bumped. Please escalate if errors climb above 1% again or latency >3s p95.

oncall_elena: taking handoff. I’ll monitor dashboards and coordinate the postmortem write-up. PS: add links to deploys and exact config deltas in the ticket.

incident-bot: Note: pagerduty handoff recorded. Next oncall: oncall_elena.

mike: thanks everyone — I’ll notify customer success for AcmeCorp + BetaLabs with the impact blurb and ETA for follow-up. :thumbsup:

jess: marking temporary instrumentation tickets: ENG-STOPGAP-245 (request-id), ENG-STOPGAP-246 (jaeger sampling), ENG-STOPGAP-247 (envoy exporter).

oncall_elena: closing incident to MONITORING, will update status page if we see regression. great work. :tada:
